newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels to buy Chicago hotel.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels to buy Chicago hotel.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co. said Wednesday it has a definitive agreement to buy the Chicago Embassy Suites Hotel in Chicago for $67 million.
Interstate, which owns, manages and leases more than 200 hotels, said it expects to close the deal in March.
Chicago Embassy Suites is a 358-room upscale hotel in the centre of the city.
Pittsburgh-based Interstate's stock edged down 12.5 cents to $29.125 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
